comment: Teacher accurately explains sanding purposes, grit selection, pre-sanding, tool choice, bench hook/vice/chisel/saw use, and assembly problem diagnosis.
Lesson progresses from learning goal and success criteria to review, demonstration, guided practice, independent practice, and share-out/problem solving.
Teacher uses turn-and-talk, repeated hands-up checks, table monitoring, student explanations, and immediate feedback during workshop practice.
Teacher asks why/how/tool-choice questions and uses student reasoning about grit, sanding blocks, inaccessible faces, and fixing material-fit problems.
Strong lesson overall, with minor opportunities to make some safety/PPE and grit-marking conventions more explicit.
